description: The German Dam Committee (DTK) produced a list of the 380 large dams in Germany, those 15 m or more high from the lowest point of the foundation to the crest under the ICOLD definition, with a short description of each and a map of the larger dams. Coverage is Germany. The list is free to view online. Caveats: the many smaller impoundments are left out because the Länder water laws define dams differently, and the map is under revision and incomplete. Simulation uses: a national dam inventory for dam break exposure and reservoir resilience studies. Related records: GRanD (data-grand-global-reservoir-and-dam-database) and the Global Dam Watch database (data-global-dam-watch-database).
